style.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: Tokyo Liftoff Omarchy wallpaper. Image 1 is the exact engine-cluster photograph to edit; image 2 supplies only Tokyo Liftoff colour and atmospheric styling. Restyle image 1 into the same refined midnight navy, periwinkle blue, lavender, violet and luminous pink treatment as image 2. Keep the exact 3:2 composition, camera angle, circular arrangement, count, positions, shapes and overlap of every visible engine bell, existing smoke boundaries and exhaust geometry. Render subtle painterly atmospheric clouds with detailed photographic metal hardware; dark upper smoke becomes navy and lavender with pink rimlight, sky midnight blue; glowing exhaust retains white-gold core, amber light and pink/lilac outer ribbons with restrained cyan/periwinkle accents. Do not invent engine bells, hardware, new sparks, stars, planets, skyline, text or logos. Retain smooth clipped highlights and original irregular smoke, no uniformly sharp cauliflower texture. Return only the complete edited first photograph, no framing change, borders, labels or layout. Maximum practical supported native resolution.
